name: cmux.composer.toolbar/1
docs: Promote existing actions of the current composer to toolbar buttons. Each visible button invokes the same handler as its + menu entry. The composer's available actions, icons and permissions apply.

action.description: The current composer command id, such as composer.attachFiles, composer.commands or composer.chooseProject.

label.description: Optional accessible name and tooltip. Defaults to the localized action title.
